exposure: Receiving formal training about PPE use
Availability of different types of PPE
outcome: Pattern of personal protective equipment (PPE) use (e.g., full PPE, specific equipment types)
Adverse events/health effects of full PPE use
cohort: The participants were 252 obstetricians and obstetric nurses from Obstetrics & Gynecology departments in three hospitals in Mansoura, Egypt.
finding: Formal training and daily work hours greater than 8 hours were significant predictors of wearing full PPE during Cesarean sections, and the most common health effect of full PPE use was a sense of heat (79.5%).
